scripts.setup:backend: cd services/tmdb && uv venv .venv --python 3.13 && uv pip install --prerelease=allow -r requirements.txt
scripts.build:docker:tmdb: docker buildx build --platform linux/amd64,linux/arm64 -t seppaleinen/worldinmovies_tmdb:latest services/tmdb
scripts.build:docker:webapp: docker buildx build --platform linux/amd64,linux/arm64 -t seppaleinen/worldinmovies_webapp:latest apps/webapp
